  function childrenOf(id) { return CHILDREN.get(id) || []; }
  function subtreeNodeIds(id) {
    const out = []; const stack = [id];
    while (stack.length) {
      const cur = stack.pop(); out.push(cur);
      childrenOf(cur).forEach(c => stack.push(c.id));
    }
    return out;

  function directEntities(id) { return DIRECT.get(id) || []; }
